drill_denominators.explanation: Rows about drill content count only drills that were made. Of 36 runs per arm, the skill declined all 15 runs without family agreement, leaving 21 (36 − 15). The plain prompt made drills in 8 of those 15 runs, giving 29 (21 + 8). The agreement row covers all 15 runs without permission.
